CarrierRef.description:
What a placement sits on (doc 12 §2.3 `CarrierRef`): `{"carrier": id}` or `{"surface": id}`. Piggy-back
mounting on another placement (1.0) is kept verbatim as [`CarrierRef::Unknown`].

Cutout.description: The class of a round cut-out (an operator's mounting hole).

Gland.description: The thread of a metric cable gland.

Hole.description:
A hole (doc 12 §2.5), tagged by its kind: `{"round": {"d": …}}`, `{"fixing": "m5"}`, `{"cutout": "d22"}`,
`{"gland": "m20"}` or `{"rect": {"w": …, "h": …, "r": …}}`.

oneOf.description: A plain hole of a diameter.
A hole for a screw that fixes the part: the shop's setting and the surface decide how it is made.
The round cut-out of an operator of a class.
The hole of a metric cable gland.
A rectangular cut-out, with a corner radius.

r.description: The corner radius; absent: square corners.

HoleChoice.description:
One hole of a placement's or a carrier's pattern moved or left out (doc 12 §2.2). A placement's choice names the
part's hole itself (`hole`, as the part gave it when the choice was made): it stays on that hole when the part's
holes are edited or its copy is replaced, and applies to none when the part no longer has it (EW-LAY-017 says so).
A carrier's fixing, which no part names, is the one at `index` counted from the start of its path; so is a
placement's choice without `hole`.

hole.description: A placement's: the part's hole it is for (its centre in the part frame and how it is named).

index.description: The hole's index in its owner's pattern when the choice was made.

offset.description: The hole moved by this offset (`u`, `v` in the surface frame); absent: at its place.

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Nm.description: A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

PartHole.description:
One hole of a part's drilling pattern ([`MechData::holes`]): its centre in the part frame (`x` right, `y` up, from
the front's bottom-left corner).

PartRef.description: A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

copy.description: The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`.

variant.description: A variant key of the part.

Pose3.description: A pose (doc 05 §3.2): translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a unit quaternion in 10^-9. JSON Schema cannot express that q is unit (within 2.001 x 10^9 of 10^18 squared) and sign-normalised (w > 0, or the first non-zero component positive); the reader rejects both.

Screw.description: The screw of a fixing hole.

SurfacePt2.description: A point [u, v] in nanometres in the frame of a mounting surface, u to the right, v up (doc 03 §16): not a sheet point.

description:
A placement (doc 03 §16 `Placement3D`, doc 12 §2.3, rank 54, the layout file of its carrier's space): a device,
or one of its functions, on a carrier at a pose relative to the carrier.

It stores no tag text (labels are `layout_label(placement)`, D-02) and no geometry: the footprint comes from the
part. A placement cannot outlive its device (delete policy cascade, EW-LAY-002) and keeps its carrier (forbid).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

carrier.description: The carrier or surface it sits on (delete policy forbid).

function.description: One function placed on its own (a door handle); absent: the whole device (delete policy cascade).

hole_choices.description:
The holes of its part moved or left out (doc 12-3d §10.4); an index the part no longer has is dropped by the
command that changes the part.

label_at.description:
Where a person moved the placement's label (or balloon) to on its layout pages: the label's anchor as an offset
from the centre of the footprint, in the surface's frame (`u` right, `v` up, nm), so that it moves with the
placement; absent: placed by the label rules (doc 12 §5.3). Additive: an older build keeps it.

locked.description: Excluded from push, swap and auto-fill (FR-LAY-006).

part.description:
The part use of the device this placement realises; absent: the primary mountable part. `layout.place`
always writes it; no delete policy: a placement whose part use left the device is reported
by EW-LAY-003, never changed silently.

pose.description:
The pose relative to the carrier: on a rail `t = (s, 0, 0)` with `q` identity or 180° about `w`; on a
surface `t = (u, v, 0)` rotated by k·90° about `w`.
